adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action does `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')` and after `host.save(props)` resolves it forcibly sets `host.category` to `Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))` instead of using the saved record/response. On the server, `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` overwrites a blank `category_id` with `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. If the user leaves `categoryId` null/blank, the server will persist uncategorized but the client will set `host.category` to `findById(null)` (likely `undefined`), so `{{category-badge host.category}}` renders empty until reload despite the record being saved with a category.
